product: CabiCAD (illustrative — replace every entry with the observed inventory)

design.label: Design
design.purpose: Lay out the room and the cabinets with the client's intent.

profile.output: Layout plan and elevations for approval

manufacture.label: Manufacture
manufacture.purpose: Turn the approved design into parts the workshop can cut.

profile.output: Cut list, part drawings and machining files

presentation.label: Presentation
presentation.purpose: Show the client what the kitchen will look like.

profile.output: Rendered views and a client PDF

installation.label: Installation
installation.purpose: Tell the installer where every unit goes and in what order.

profile.output: Installation plan with fixing points and sequence

board.switch.label: Switch board
board.switch.does: Changes the output lens over the same model; nothing in the model changes.

draw.wall.label: Wall
draw.wall.does: Draws a wall segment in the shared model.

disabled.manufacture.*: Geometry is locked here — switch to Design to change walls

place.cabinet.label: Place cabinet
place.cabinet.does: Adds a cabinet from the library to the shared model.

edit.move.label: Move
edit.move.does: Moves the selected items in the shared model.

also.why: Acts on the item under the cursor without travelling to the toolbar

dimension.add.label: Dimension
dimension.add.does: Measures between two points; the board's profile decides which measurements show and how.

layers.toggle.label: Show or hide layer
layers.toggle.does: Overrides the board profile's visibility for one layer in this view only.

output.export.label: Export
output.export.does: Produces the current board's deliverable, as named by its profile.

manufacture.cutlist.label: Cut list
manufacture.cutlist.does: Lists every part with its finished size and material.

presentation.render.label: Render view
presentation.render.does: Renders the current camera view with materials and lighting.

installation.sequence.label: Installation order
installation.sequence.does: Numbers the units in the order they are fixed to the wall.
